# C405 (inline) — guardian_handler clamps the auction_report as-of to 09:26:00. The Go config starts auction_report_0926 at 09:26:30, so 10-22's report ran with asof 09:26:30 and build_auction_panorama raised invalid_panorama_asof (V6_PANORAMA_MISSING): the V6 two-table report was missing from the mailed 10-22 auction report.
